items.title: Calcutta High Court dismisses NGO's plea for enquiry into demolition of its book stall during Durga Puja
items.summary: The Calcutta High Court on Tuesday dismissed Association for Protection of Democratic Rights' (APDR's) plea seeking an impartial, time-bound enquiry into identifying and holding accountable the persons responsible for the demolition of their temporary book stall near Jadavpur 8B Bus Stand without any prior notice during Durga Puja [Association for Protection of Democratic Rights v. The State of West Bengal and Ors.]. Justice Rishad Medora dismissed the plea on the ground that since the book stall was erected without the appropriate permission, no fundamental right of the petitioner (ADPR) was infringed. However, he noted that that ADPR was free to opt for any other remedy it deemed appropriate in pursuit of its enquiry into the demolition of its stall. "It does not appear that any fundamental right of the petitioner has been violated for it to approach this Court in its writ jurisdiction. Since no affidavit has been called for, the allegations made in the writ petition are deemed not to have been admitted by the respondents. The petitioner will be at liberty to pursue other remedies, if any, available to it in respect of the aforesaid demolition. The writ petition stands dismissed

CMS INDUSLAW advised Focus Prism and its promoter on both the transactions. The transaction team consisted of Rashi Bharadwaj (Partner), Shivani Singh (Principal Associate) and Rusha Ghosh Dastidar (Senior Associate), with Avimukt Dar (Founding Partner) providing strategic inputs. The corporate secretarial team comprised Ruhi Jain (Executive Director), Praveen Hedge (Manager), Adarsh Joshi (Assistant Manager) and Fhareen Abdul Aziz Khan (Executive). Focus Prime Focus Prism is a leading tech-enabled, institutional food services platform in India, delivering everyday large-scale, high-quality food solutions across corporate, industrial, education and healthcare segments. The investment strengthens its investor base, while the acquisition expands its institutional food services operations.
